clarifications.title: Fingerprint / biometric security must be explicitly implemented as part of the existing identity/security requirements
clarifications.provenance: Recovered Command Center history from 2026-10-19 plus James's 2026-10-23 reaffirmation.
clarifications.binding_interpretation: The existing passkey/WebAuthn/biometric requirements must result in real fingerprint/device-biometric-backed owner unlock on compatible Samsung/Android platform authenticators, automatic relock, fresh user verification for protected actions, secure credential recovery/revocation, and no biometric-template storage. This is roadmap surfacing/clarification of existing scope, not a new feature count.

clarifications.title: Reliable installed-PWA/application updates must be explicitly implemented as part of the existing PWA/release/recovery requirements
clarifications.provenance: Existing canonical update requirements plus James's 2026-10-23 reaffirmation after stale-version behavior.
clarifications.binding_interpretation: The existing update/version/cache/recovery requirements must produce a reliable installed-PWA update lifecycle: immutable release identity, active update discovery, complete install before activation, no mixed-version runtime/cache state, controlled activation/reload, update observability, known-good offline preservation, rollback, and physical Samsung update acceptance. This is roadmap surfacing/clarification of existing scope, not a new feature count.
